icp: Creators who need text-to-speech: voiceover, narration, dubbing, and audiobook workflows, not dictation users.
pain: Creator tooling already integrates the hosted ElevenLabs API shape, and those clients send voice_settings such as speed; silently dropping them makes the local endpoint produce the wrong narration pacing for existing pipelines.
revenueHypothesis: Honoring voice_settings.speed makes the ElevenLabs-compatible endpoint behaviorally compatible for real client payloads, deepening drop-in adoption of the local studio in paid creator workflows.
mvpAcceptance: POST /v1/text-to-speech/{voice_id} validates voice_settings types and ranges (stability, similarity_boost, style in 0-1; speed in the backend-supported 0.25-4.0; use_speaker_boost boolean) and rejects invalid values with 422
voice_settings.speed is passed through to the existing synthesis speed parameter so a request with speed 1.5 produces audio synthesized at speed 1.5
New mocked-backend pytest coverage for validation and speed pass-through passes, and the existing elevenlabs_compat and router smoke suites still pass

publicPatternSources: ElevenLabs public API documentation voice_settings field names and ranges only; no proprietary code, assets, or branding copied

stopConditions: Stop after this single slice once the draft PR is open and independently verified
Stop if CI cannot run on the fork or the check run cannot be verified live
Stop if any change would touch LICENSE, store/marketplace paths, GPU/hosted inference, or public copy naming a person
rollback: Revert the single slice commit on branch helix/elevenlabs-voice-settings and close the draft PR; no database or settings migrations are introduced.

vercel.exceptionReason: Voice Studio is a local-first desktop application (Tauri shell plus local FastAPI backend) that runs on the user's own machine; there is no hosted web deployment to verify on Vercel.
